title: Sweet and Spicy Gochujang Sauce
summary: Gochujang, soy sauce, rice vinegar, brown sugar, garlic, ginger and sesame oil whisked into a glossy glaze for fried chicken.

steps.title: Whisk the sauce
steps.text: In the large bowl, whisk the gochujang, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, garlic, ginger and sesame oil until the sugar has dissolved.

steps.title: Adjust the thickness
steps.text: Add the water a little at a time until the sauce just falls off a spoon; gochujang thickness varies between brands.

steps.title: Coat and serve
steps.text: Tip hot fried chicken into the bowl and toss to coat in a glossy layer. Serve straight away while the coating is crisp.

tips: Toss just before serving so the chicken stays crunchy.
Scatter with sesame seeds and sliced spring onion.
Make it milder with a little less gochujang and a spoonful of honey.
Also good brushed on roast chicken or tofu.
storage: Keep the uncooked sauce covered in the fridge for up to 1 week. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
